info.title: FAR / DFARS & CMMC Clause Risk Scanner API
info.description: High-performance, stateless Defense & Federal GovCon regulatory compliance microservice. Scans Section I / Section K federal solicitation and contract text to extract FAR, DFARS, and agency supplement clauses, flags mandatory subcontractor flow-downs, identifies high-burden compliance triggers (Cost Accounting Standards, Buy American/BAA, Unlimited Technical Data Rights), and computes an actionable CMMC 2.0 / NIST SP 800-171 / DFARS 7012/7019/7020/7021 cyber readiness profile.

post.summary: Scan federal solicitations for FAR/DFARS clauses, flow-downs & CMMC/FedRAMP burden
post.description: Detects every Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR 52.2xx), Defense Federal Acquisition Regulation Supplement (DFARS 252.2xx), and agency supplement clause in a solicitation or subcontract. Flags mandatory subcontractor flow-downs, evaluates CMMC 2.0 / NIST SP 800-171 / FedRAMP compliance profiles, highlights government IP/data rights traps, and scores overall compliance burden (0-100).

get.description: Unprotected health check endpoint for marketplace SLA monitoring.

ContractorRole.description: Evaluate clause applicability and flow-down risk from the perspective of a 'prime_contractor', 'subcontractor', or 'commercial_item_vendor'.

ClauseRiskSeverity.description: Operational, financial, or legal risk severity for the contractor (LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, CRITICAL).

ComplianceBurdenLevel.description: Categorical compliance burden level (LOW, MODERATE, HIGH, EXTREME_DEFENSE_GRADE).

CMMCLevelRequired.description: Highest CMMC 2.0 certification level required or implied by the solicitation clauses.

raw_text.description: Raw text from RFP Section I (Contract Clauses), subcontract flow-down exhibit, or federal solicitation.
raw_text.example: SECTION I - CONTRACT CLAUSES: This solicitation incorporates by reference: FAR 52.215-2 (Audit and Records - Negotiation), FAR 52.230-2 (Cost Accounting Standards), DFARS 252.204-7012 (Safeguarding Covered Defense Information and Cyber Incident Reporting), DFARS 252.204-7020 (NIST SP 800-171 DoD Assessment Requirements), DFARS 252.204-7021 (Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification Requirements - CMMC Level 2 Required), and DFARS 252.227-7013 (Rights in Technical Data - Noncommercial Items; Government demands Unlimited Rights in all deliverables developed under this contract).

handles_cui_or_cdi.description: Whether the contractor will store, process, or transmit Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) or Covered Defense Information (CDI).

compliance_impact_summary.example: Requires active CMMC Level 2 certification at the time of contract award and throughout performance.

recommended_action_or_exception.example: Verify C3PAO assessment status and flow down CMMC Level 2 requirements to all subcontractors handling CUI.
